preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The length of strings A and B is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive, and they are equal in length.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == count of cyclic permutations of B[i] that give 0 when XORed with A[i] for each test case
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output should be the count of cyclic permutations of B that, when XORed with A, result in 0.
